ADR VAL - Implantable Loop Recorder Implantation
Salient Features
Clinical Profile


Patient with syncope undergoing implantable loop recorder placement for further rhythm evaluation (ICD-10: R55).


Procedure


Abbott Assert implantable loop recorder inserted using standard precordial insertion technique.


Disposition


Procedure completed with mild additional oozing managed with a single absorbable stitch. Steri-Strips applied. No antibiotics prescribed.


Procedure Summary
The patient underwent implantation of an Abbott Assert implantable loop recorder for evaluation of syncope. Standard precordial insertion technique was utilized. The loop recorder was inserted successfully without documented complications. A mild amount of additional oozing was noted at the insertion site and was controlled with placement of a single absorbable stitch. Steri-Strips were applied for wound support. No antibiotics were prescribed following the procedure.
Detailed Procedure
After informed consent was obtained, the patient was prepared for implantation of an implantable loop recorder for evaluation of syncope. The precordial area was selected as the insertion site and prepared using standard sterile technique.
An Abbott Assert implantable loop recorder was inserted using the standard precordial insertion technique. Following placement of the device, a mild amount of additional oozing was noted from the insertion site. Hemostasis was achieved with placement of a single absorbable stitch. Steri-Strips were subsequently applied.
The patient tolerated the procedure well. No additional complications were documented. No antibiotics were prescribed following the procedure.
